netlifyRouting: netlify.toml:12-15 rewrites /api/* -> /.netlify/functions/:splat (status 200). Background worker: netlify/functions/storyline-background.ts (config type 'background', storyline-background.ts:49) reached via POST {origin}/.netlify/functions/storyline-background (_shared/trigger.ts:35-41).

methodHandling.otherMethods: Method is never checked. GET/HEAD requests have no body, so req.json() throws SyntaxError -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"} (after auth). Any other method with a valid JSON body behaves exactly like POST.

auth.notes: Auth runs first, before body parse. Missing/non-Bearer Authorization -> 401 'Missing bearer token' (_shared/http.ts:20-25). Token equal to DEV_SECRET_KEY -> dev user (DEV_USER_ID; 500 'DEV_SECRET_KEY set but DEV_USER_ID missing' if unset) (_shared/auth.ts:14-20). Otherwise Supabase auth.getUser; failure -> 401 'Invalid or expired session' (_shared/auth.ts:22-23).

request.contentType: application/json (content-type header not checked; body parsed with req.json())
request.parse: const inputs = await req.json() (storyline.ts:11). Malformed/empty JSON -> SyntaxError -> errorResponse -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"}. JSON null or a non-object -> inputs?.topic falsy -> 400 'Topic is required'.

fields.name: topic
fields.validation: truthy check only: !inputs?.topic -> 400 'Topic is required' (any truthy value, e.g. a number, passes)

fields.name: numSlides
fields.validation: inputs.numSlides < 1 -> 400 'Slides must be at least 1'. JS comparison: missing/undefined passes (undefined < 1 is false); null, 0, negatives, '0', false and '' fail; non-numeric strings like 'abc' pass (NaN < 1 false).

fields.name: company, audience, style, brandId, primaryColor, accentColor, fontStyle, styleInstructions, context, keyMessages, language
fields.validation: None in the foreground. Passed verbatim to the background as `inputs`; storyline-background uses inputs.brandId (resolveBrandKitRaw), inputs.styleInstructions, inputs.language; generateStoryline consumes the rest.

request.unknownFields: Ignored by validation but forwarded verbatim inside `inputs` to the background and echoed back in the storyline-status result.inputs (storyline-background.ts:31).

checkOrder: 6. triggerStorylineBackground({jobId, userId, inputs}, origin) — failures swallowed

errors.when: malformed JSON body, Netlify Blobs write failure, any non-HttpError

sideEffects: POST {origin}/.netlify/functions/storyline-background with {jobId, userId, inputs}; up to 3 attempts with 200ms/600ms delays; never throws (_shared/trigger.ts:1-25,35-41)

Background (not part of this response): Claude call, then writes storyline/{jobId}.json = {status:'done', userId, result:{presentationTitle, inputs, slides:[...slide, prompt], warnings}} or {status:'error', userId, error} (storyline-background.ts:20-45)
externalCalls: None in the foreground. Background calls Anthropic (generateStoryline, requireEnv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), model STORYLINE_MODEL default 'claude-sonnet-4-6') — PAID (storyline-background.ts:20; _shared/config.ts:33)
quirks: Trigger failures are swallowed: the 202 is returned even if the background never started; storyline-status then reports {status:'pending'} forever (_shared/trigger.ts:3-25). Frontend gives up after 90 polls x 2s with 'Storyline timed out — please try again' (src/lib/api.ts:48-61).
No per-user cap and no upper slide-count cap (comment storyline.ts:13-14; test 'accepts large slide counts' _tests/storyline.test.ts:33-38).
numSlides validation is a raw JS `<` comparison (see field notes) — missing numSlides is accepted.
beforeAnyState: Stateless submit; always creates a new job. No idempotency key.

tests.asserts: 202 + string jobId; writeStorylineJob(jobId,{status:'pending',userId:'u1'}); trigger arg {jobId,userId,inputs}; numSlides large accepted; numSlides<1 -> 400; unauthenticated -> 401 (lines 20-52)

callers.where: src/lib/api.ts:23-25 (startStoryline), used by src/pages/IntakeChat.tsx:3 and the wizard form
none (Connector builds the storyline itself and calls /api/generate directly)

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:550-582 — matches path/method/202 {jobId}. Discrepancies: WizardInputs (openapi.yaml:73-91) marks topic, company, numSlides, audience, style as required and numSlides maximum 12; the handler only requires topic, numSlides is optional and has no max. No 400/401/500 responses documented.
docs.postman: docs/postman_collection.json '2 · Full Deck Flow' POST /api/storyline — body matches; consistent.
